pellet.concept: frozen D2 shell holding liquid He-3 at ~1.5 K (He-3 does not solidify below ~29 bar)

beam_ports.mitigation: final-focus dog-leg: the line of sight ends in a LiH beam dump as thick as the crew core

pellet_bore.mitigation: on-axis LiH plug behind the injector breech; the crew trunk lies on this axis

limits: first-order exponential removal; no build-up factor, no secondary (n,gamma) photons, no scatter around the rim
neutron spectrum taken as D-D 2.45 MeV; the 14.1 MeV D-T share needs a longer relaxation length
hardware decades are a placeholder (cryogenic heating, activation, electronics) until a transport calculation
edge-on radiator planes are exempt from the shadow; their edge and rim-scatter exposure is not computed
struts carry thrust only; the GN-scale attraction between coaxial loops is inside the virial nozzle mass, its load paths are not designed
wing spars sized per metre (in-plane thrust loads are tiny); manoeuvre, deployment and habitat-spin-up loads are unresolved
no dynamic (pulse-rate) fatigue analysis: 100 Hz for 5.7 years is ~1.8e10 load cycles on the nozzle structure

W3.note: three wings between the existing blades (30/150/270 deg)

ENVELOPE.note: W3 limited to the habitat-ring radius: rejects 2.6 % of the warm heat
